occurrences.text: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
